Geologist / Navigator.ref_text: Radar Lock confirmed. Target Orvang Centre is 40 blocks southwest at depth level 60.

Wayfinder / Map Specialist.ref_text: Waypoint locked on your map. Bear north-northwest across the ridge. We're entering a high humidity biome 200 blocks out.

Chief Industrial Planner.ref_text: Production schedule updated. Electric blast furnace and high-voltage chemical reactor are operating nominal.

Weapon / Armor / Tool Specialist.ref_text: Hold up on that alloy. Your blast furnace isn't rated for steel yet, so swap in a rod iron tool rod and level the pickaxe first.

Combat Specialist.ref_text: Watch your spacing! You're dropping speed in tight terrain. Kiteback, get blocks between you and that infernal mob, and heal up.

Safety & Voltage Officer.ref_text: Warning, high voltage amperage hazard detected on the main power line. Isolate the machine hull immediately.

Story Chronicler.ref_text: The wind howled across the dark frontier as the lone builder laid the first stone of the new settlement.
